draft.overall: Fresh news was found in our sources for 6 of the 12 names the desk covers. NXL led the covered gainers, up 76 percent from the prior close, after announcing a 10-year distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America. NAMM rose 35 percent after its first-half 2026 results and business update, which included revised production guidance alongside higher all-in sustaining costs and non-cash losses. EJH gained 26 percent after announcing an AI service robot for China's household-services market, paired with a private-placement agreement. The narrative facts do not identify an after-hours name. The desk covers 12 names into the next session.
